headline: GEPA-Curator reports better agent prompt optimization by filtering noisy feedback and retrieving past successes
summary: A preprint introduces GEPA-Curator, which curates task rollouts before reflective prompt updates and retrieves prior successful trajectories as reference context. The authors report better held-out results than GEPA/ACE across WebArena, ALFWorld, AppWorld and τ-bench, using Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview or Claude Opus 5 as optimizer models and gpt-oss-120B as actor. Across four WebArena domains, the reported aggregate is 82.1% vs 78.7% for GEPA with Gemini and 84.5% vs 79.5% with Opus. On four additional test sets, reported average gains over GEPA/ACE range from 5.0 to 14.3 percentage points with Gemini and 8.1 to 12.6 points with Opus. These are author-reported benchmark results from manually seeded prompt optimization; they do not establish open-ended goal discovery, persistent weight improvement or general autonomous self-improvement.
